title: Sleep Timer Audit
summary: A sleep timer in every player that fades out and pauses after 15, 30 or 60 minutes or at the end of the episode, remembered per profile on the server.

history.text: Follow-up: ticked bug-1 and ux-1, added perf-1.

mustFix.title: End of episode stops on the next episode instead

items.title: End of episode stops after autoplay has started the next one
items.what: The timer listens for `ended`, but autoplay starts the next episode first, so it pauses 2 seconds into it.
items.fix: Check the timer before autoplay picks the next item.

items.title: Countdown drifts while the tab is in the background
items.what: Uses setInterval ticks rather than an end time.
items.fix: Store the end time and compute what's left.

doneWell: The fade uses the player's own volume, so the user's volume comes back after.

items.title: Settings are fetched again on every player open
items.what: Already in the profile query cache.

items.title: New field not optional in FlexarrKit
items.fix: `public var sleepTimer: SleepTimer? = nil`, noted “Absent from servers before 0.57”.

items.title: Timer button has no VoiceOver label
Shake to extend by 15 minutes on iPhone
items.what: Audiobook apps do this; easy with the motion API.

items.what: A service call, for bedtime automations.
